title: Global Agility Datapack
description: Makes every entity capable of climbing at least 1 block
body:
# 🏃‍♂️ Make your worlds more fast-paced using Global Agility!
Once the datapack is loaded, every entity that spawns has its attributes changed so they can climb a full block without jumping! (similar to how horses move)
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/CC8S1al-Asw" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>


# ⚠ Important notes!
- **This datapack affects sneaking mechanics**. You can no longer stand near blocks without falling if the gap is just 1 block high, it will snap you down instead. For higher altitudes, sneaking still works fine.

- Once installed, ALL EXISTING MOBS get their attributes modified, **make sure you have a backup** if you're not sure about installing this or you just want to try it out.

  You can try uninstalling it using 
  ```
  /function axz_agility:uninstall
  ```
    **_However, it may not affect unloaded entities or offline players, so consider this a permanent change in your world._**
